separation_justification: For P subset [0,Q], the two components of P union(L-P) are separated by at least L-2Q. To exclude a crossing pattern of width at most Q, require L-2Q>Q, i.e. L>3Q. The former L>2Q fails for Q=3,P={0,3},L=7, where {3,4} crosses the gap. Taking L larger leaves the intended existence/linear-independence argument intact.
